article.headline: Justice Smith's 17 points lead Niagara past Saint Francis of Pennsylvania 69-66
article.description: — Justice Smith scored 17 points and Niagara beat Saint Francis of Pennsylvania 69-66 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Justice Smith's 17 points lead Niagara past Saint Francis of Pennsylvania 69-66
article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — Justice Smith scored 17 points and Niagara beat Saint Francis of Pennsylvania 69-66 on Saturday night. Smith had five rebounds for the Purple Eagles (5-6). Jahari Williamson scored 14 points while going 4 of 9 (4 for 8 from 3-point range). Justin Page had 12 points and went 5 of 13 from the field (2 for 7 from 3-point range). The Red Flash (2-7) were led by Miles Webb, who posted 17 points and 10 rebounds. Juan Cranford Jr. added 13 points for Saint Francis. Jeremy Clayville had 10 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
